note: Set A captures the key mechanical facts — horizontal louvered configuration, closing of louvers to shade the south façade, rotational movement driven by a Nitinol wire actuator using the sun's latent energy with no additional energy sources — which Set B omits entirely. Set B is dominated by repeated 20% glazing claims, one of which misattributes the percentage to the HARVEST SCREEN and another with a malformed '20% %' value, plus a trivial rendering claim and a spliced quote. Set A also has flaws (two claims misbinding the 20% glazing share to the screens, a mislabeled 'composition' claim, and an odd Phototrophic condition), but its claims are more numerous, better bound and better supported overall.
